lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three staggered vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels superior to a shadowed trough.
